resources.string: Every frame is processed on the phone, so expect seconds per frame: a one-minute clip can take hours. Short clips are best.
Each whole frame goes through the upscaler chosen in the Images module, then is scaled to the output size: sharper detail, no cropping or zoom.
Adds a frame between every two. The in-between frame is a blend of its neighbours, not a neural interpolation, so fast motion can look ghosted.
Done. The video is saved to Movies/ModulAI.
No upscaler model is installed. Download one in the Images module (Models section).
